[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-02T17:29:00) Tim: Learning German has been tough but worth it. I like the structure of the language, it's much easier when I took French in high school. What made you decide to learn Spanish? [shares a photo: a photo of a book sitting on a table next to a wall]
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-02T17:32:00) Tim: Thanks! I appreciate your encouragement. I'm definitely going to keep up with my German lessons. Do you still play basketball often?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-02T17:28:30) John: Wow! Impressive you're learning German. I know a bit of it myself and Spanish, it makes travel so much easier. How's it going with your language studies?
 [shares a photo: a photo of a book with a red cover and white title]
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-07T17:28:00) Tim: Cool, let me know if you're around!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-07T17:33:00) Tim: I hope you enjoy it! Let me know your thoughts.
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-02T17:30:00) Tim: Yeah, knowing another language opens up a lot of opportunities. Have you come across any good resources for learning Spanish? I've been using this app. [shares a photo: a photo of a cell phone sitting on a notebook with a smiley face app]
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-12-08T19:47:00) Tim: Sounds cool! Let me know the title so I can add it to my list!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-12-08T19:50:00) Tim: Let me know if you get around to them! Have a great day!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-12T13:48:00) Tim: Cheers! I owe you one. Let me know if you need anything. Bye!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-12-06T17:43:00) Tim: Thanks! Appreciate the offer. Let me know if you can lend a hand. Bye!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-09-21T20:22:30) Tim: Glad you liked it. Let me know if you need any more suggestions.
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-02T17:31:00) Tim: That app is great. Learning another language is tough, but the rewards are totally worth it.
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-08-26T19:05:00) Tim: Yep, I'll let you know! Thanks for being so helpful.
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-08-09T10:37:00) Tim: No problem! Let me know what you think after you read it.
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-08-31T14:58:00) Tim: Thanks! I'll definitely have a blast. I'll let you know how it goes!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-10-13T13:59:00) Tim: No worries. Let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with. Always here to help!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-10-21T17:51:00) Tim: Hey John! Haven't talked to you in a bit but wanted to let you know I read this awesome book about castles in the UK. It was so interesting and blew me away! I dream of visiting them one day.
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-12-11T20:28:30) Tim: Hey John, I had a tough time with my English lit class. Did an analysis on this series and I think it went ok!
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-08-02T16:17:30) John: Hey Tim! Congrats on the opportunity to write about what you're into! How did it happen?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-10-21T17:57:00) Tim: Nice job, John! What did you write on that whiteboard?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-07-16T16:33:30) Tim: Wow! How long have you been surfing?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-10-17T13:51:30) Tim: Wow! Mentoring must be so rewarding. You get to show others what you know - that's awesome! Is it difficult? Any hiccups?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-05-21T19:48:00) John: Hey Tim, nice to meet you! What's up? Anything new happening?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2024-01-07T17:29:00) Tim: Wow! How did the game go?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-08-31T14:54:00) Tim: Wow, that looks great! How did you make it? Do you have a recipe you can share?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-07-16T16:30:30) Tim: Cool! What do you love about Seattle?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-09-21T20:17:00) John: Hey Tim, been a while! How ya been?
[WORLD] (mentioned: 2023-06-15T17:15:00) Tim: Wow! That's awesome! Were you playing or watching?
